Same 6 convenios as the permisos eval (2, 3, 10, 18, 20, 25), reused for continuity and because plan §D.10's own named traps (c.18's dual-unit sentence, c.20's declining schedule) live inside this set. That schedule is used here as a NEGATIVE/restraint gold entry instead (see quotes/c20_p9-10.txt for the full finding). The genuine 'multi-year schedule in one fact' test case (D5's precedent) is instead covered by c.2 (3-year) and c.3 (4-year), both real vacaciones multi-year schedules found live.
